_metadata.et_product_long_name: ECOSTRESS Tiled Evapotranspiration Instantaneous and Daytime L3 Global 70 m v002
_metadata.lst_product_long_name: ECOSTRESS Tiled Land Surface Temperature and Emissivity Instantaneous L2 Global 70 m v002
_metadata.sampling: Point extraction at each district headquarters coordinate; one 70 m pixel per overpass.
_metadata.temporal_note: ECOSTRESS has a non-sun-synchronous, precessing ISS orbit; revisit times are irregular and vary from hours to days. Discrete observations are kept as-is; no temporal interpolation.
_metadata.timezone: Asia/Dhaka (UTC+06:00; Bangladesh has no daylight saving)
_metadata.solar_elevation_method: NOAA approximate solar position from UTC timestamp and overpass latitude/longitude; used only for the day/night flag.
_metadata.lst_daytime_series_note: lst_series_daytime contains only LST observations with solar elevation > 0. The full lst_series retains both day and night overpasses; no interpolation.
_metadata.et_day_night_note: ETdaily is a daylight-integrated daily product; the day/night flag describes the overpass timestamp, not the ET integration window.

units.et_daily_mm_per_day: mm/day (native ECO_L3T_JET.002 ETdaily; LP DAAC ECO_L2-4 Grid Tile User Guide V2 section 5.4 defines ETdaily as the daily integrated ET in millimeters per day)

_metadata.unit_note: The Earthdata catalog table labels ETdaily as W/m2, but the LP DAAC User Guide V2 section 5.4 defines ETdaily as the daily ET integrated over daylight hours in mm/day. The downloaded values (0-5.93, median 1.86) are consistent with mm/day. Native values are reported as mm/day without rescaling.

qc_rules.et: ETdaily retained when 0 <= ETdaily <= 100 mm/day; no QC layer exists in ECO_L3T_JET.002.
qc_rules.lst: LST retained only when cloud mask is Clear, L1B data quality is Good, the mandatory QA flag confirms the pixel was produced by TES, LST accuracy is not ">2 K (poor)", and 250 K < LST < 350 K.
